tools.name: process
tools.description: Start, inspect, wait for, or stop a managed long-running process. The command already runs in the background: do not use &, nohup, disown or daemonizing. Background children are killed when the command exits.

action.description: Usually inferred from command or id.

command.description: Shell command to start. It already runs in the background; do not add &, nohup or disown.

stdin.description: Text written once to the started command's standard input, e.g. a script for `python3 -` or `node -`; the input is then closed.

cwd.description: Working directory for start. Defaults to the workspace.

id.description: Id returned by a prior start.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time wait blocks; clamped to session policy.
